title_en: Artificial Intelligence (5/20): Robots in the Factory
note_en: 与其…不如… weighs two options and recommends the second: 与其担心工作被机器人抢走，不如主动学习怎么跟机器人配合工作 "rather than worrying about robots taking your job, you'd do better to learn to work with them." English puts "rather than" first in the same way, but Chinese needs the matching 不如 at the start of the second clause. A related pattern appears later: 宁愿…也不愿意… "would rather... than..."
